game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Castle Gatehouse, the fortified castle gatehouse: the knight must hold off bandits while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Variable Crates: Drag collected coins into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the castle gate.
theme: The Kingdom – Castle Gatehouse: the fortified castle gatehouse
core_gameplay_loop: In Castle Gatehouse, repeat each round: Drag collected coins into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the castle gate. Then check crate_b and advance.
player_objective: Protect the castle gate from bandits in Castle Gatehouse: keep crate_b above zero until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 1 (intro tier): Variable Crates
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 1, Level 1, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
